chunks: And from him, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from a man, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
There is no sahw in the Maghrib and Fajr prayers.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, the source of the reported ruling
key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: the Fajr prayer, the dawn salat
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset salat
key_terms.سَهْوٌ: forgetfulness or inadvertent error in salat

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on sahw in the Maghrib and Fajr prayers according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning forgetfulness in salat, specifically for the Maghrib and Fajr prayers. It indicates that the rules of sahw do not apply in these two prayers in the same manner as in other prayers, making it a significant text in Shiʿi prayer rulings.
